value.zh: 孔光、何武奏：「迭毀之次當以時定，請與群臣雜議。」
value.en: Kong Guang and He Wu memorialized, "The sequence for successive removal from the temple should be fixed according to the times—we request to deliberate with the ministers."
value.literal: Kong Guang and He Wu memorialized: "The sequence for successive removal from the temple should be fixed according to the times—we request to deliberate mixed with the ministers."

value.zh: 於是光祿勳彭宣等五十三人皆以為：「孝武皇帝雖有功烈，親盡宜毀。」
value.en: Thereupon Director of the Secretariat Peng Xuan and fifty-three others all held, "Although Emperor Xiaowu had meritorious achievements, when his line of descent is exhausted he should be removed from the temple."
value.literal: Thereupon Director of the Secretariat Peng Xuan and fifty-three others all held: "Although Emperor Xiaowu had meritorious achievements, when kin is exhausted he should be removed from the temple."

value.zh: 太僕王舜、中壘校尉劉歆議曰：「《禮》，天子七廟。
value.en: Grand Master of Equipage Wang Shun and Commandant of the Inner Ramparts Liu Xin argued, "In the Rites, the Son of Heaven has seven temples.
value.literal: Grand Master of Equipage Wang Shun and Commandant of the Inner Ramparts Liu Xin deliberated, saying: "In the Rites, the Son of Heaven has seven temples.

value.zh: 七者其正法數，可常數者也。
value.en: Seven is the correct standard number—the number that may remain constant.
value.literal: Seven is the correct standard number—the number that may be constant.

value.en: An honored ancestor is not within this number—honored ancestor is an exception.
value.literal: An 'honored ancestor' is not within this number—'honored ancestor' is a change.

value.zh: 苟有功德則宗之，不可預為設數。
value.en: If there are merit and achievement, then one honors him as an ancestor—the number cannot be set in advance.
value.literal: If there are merit and achievement, then one honors him as an ancestor—it cannot be predetermined and a number set in advance.

value.zh: 臣愚以為孝武皇帝功烈如彼，孝宣皇帝崇立之如此，不宜毀。」
value.en: Your servant foolishly considers that Emperor Xiaowu's achievements were as great as they were, and Emperor Xiaoxuan exalted him as he did—he should not be removed from the temple."
value.literal: Your servant foolishly considers that Emperor Xiaowu's achievements and merit were as they were, and Emperor Xiaoxuan exalted and established him as he did—he should not be removed."

value.zh: 上覽其議，制曰：「太僕舜、中壘校尉歆議可。」
value.en: The emperor reviewed their deliberation and decreed, "The argument of Grand Master of Equipage Shun and Commandant of the Inner Ramparts Xin is accepted."
value.literal: The emperor reviewed their deliberation and decreed: "The deliberation of Grand Master of Equipage Shun and Commandant of the Inner Ramparts Xin is acceptable."

value.zh: 議郎耿育上書冤訟陳湯曰：「甘延壽、陳湯，為聖漢揚鉤深致遠之威，雪國家累年之恥，討絕域不羈之君，系萬里難制之虜，豈有比哉！
value.en: Remonstrance Officer Geng Yu submitted a memorial pleading Chen Tang's case, saying, "Gan Yanshou and Chen Tang displayed holy Han's power to strike deep and reach far, wiped away years of national shame, punished a lord of the distant realm who would not submit, and bound a captive hard to control across ten thousand li—has anything compared!
value.literal: Remonstrance Officer Geng Yu submitted a memorial pleading Chen Tang's wrong, saying: "Gan Yanshou and Chen Tang for holy Han displayed the authority of hooking deep and reaching far, wiped away the state's shame accumulated over years, punished the lord of the distant realm who would not submit, and bound the captive hard to control across ten thousand li—has anything compared!

value.zh: 先帝嘉之，仍下明詔，宣著其功，改年垂歷，傳之無窮。
value.en: The former emperor praised them and issued a bright edict proclaiming their merit; the reign era was changed and handed down through the calendar to be transmitted without end.
value.literal: The former emperor praised them and again issued a bright edict, proclaiming and making manifest their merit; the reign year was changed and handed down through the calendar, transmitted without end.

value.zh: 應是，南郡獻白虎，邊垂無警備。
value.en: In response, Nanyang presented a white tiger and the border marches needed no alarm.
value.literal: In response to this, Nanyang presented a white tiger; the border marches had no alarms or guards needed.

value.zh: 會先帝寢疾，然猶垂竟不忘，數使尚書責問丞相，趣立其功；
value.en: When the former emperor fell gravely ill, even at the end he did not forget, repeatedly sending the Master of Documents to reproach the Chancellor and urge that their merit be established;
value.literal: It happened that the former emperor fell gravely ill, yet even at the end he did not forget, repeatedly sending the Master of Documents to reproach and question the Chancellor, urging that their merit be established;

value.zh: 獨丞相匡衡排而不予，封延壽、湯數百戶，此功臣戰士所以失望也。
value.en: only Chancellor Kuang Heng blocked it and would not grant proper reward, enfeoffing Yanshou and Tang with only several hundred households—this is why meritorious soldiers were disappointed.
value.literal: only Chancellor Kuang Heng blocked and would not grant it, enfeoffing Yanshou and Tang with several hundred households—this is why meritorious ministers and fighting soldiers were disappointed.

value.zh: 孝成皇帝承建業之基，乘征伐之威，兵革不動，國家無事，而大臣傾邪，欲專主威，排妒有功，使湯塊然被冤拘囚，不能自明，卒以無罪老棄。
value.en: Emperor Cheng inherited an established foundation and the prestige of conquest—arms were not moved and the state was at peace, yet great ministers were crooked, wishing to monopolize authority, excluding and envying the meritorious, leaving Tang alone wronged, imprisoned, unable to clear himself, and in the end cast off in old age though guiltless.
value.literal: Emperor Cheng inherited the foundation of established enterprise and rode the authority of campaigns and punishments—arms were not moved, the state had no troubles, yet great ministers were crooked, wishing to monopolize authority, excluding and envying the meritorious, making Tang stand alone wronged, bound and imprisoned, unable to clear himself, and in the end, though guiltless, cast off in old age.

value.zh: 敦煌正當西域通道，令威名折衝之臣，旋踵及身，復為郅支遺虜所笑，誠可悲也！
value.en: Dunhuang lies on the Western Regions route—when a minister whose renown once turned enemies at the frontier suffers within a turning of the heel and is laughed at again by Zhizhi's surviving captives, it is truly pitiable!
value.literal: Dunhuang lies right on the Western Regions route—making a minister whose renown turned enemies at the frontier, within a turning of the heel suffer upon his person, again laughed at by Zhizhi's surviving captives—is truly pitiable!

value.zh: 至今奉使外蠻者，未嘗不陳郅支之誅以揚漢國之盛。
value.en: Down to the present, envoys to outer barbarians never fail to cite the execution of Zhizhi to display Han magnificence.
value.literal: Down to the present, envoys sent to outer barbarians have never failed to cite the execution of Zhizhi to display the Han state's magnificence.

value.zh: 夫援人之功以懼敵，棄人之身以快讒，豈不痛哉！
value.en: To use another man's merit to frighten enemies yet abandon his person to please slanderers—how is it not painful!
value.literal: To use another man's merit to frighten enemies yet abandon another man's person to please slanderers—how is it not painful!

value.zh: 且安不忘危，盛必慮衰，今國家素無文帝累年節儉富饒之畜，又無武帝薦延梟俊禽敵之臣，獨有一陳湯耳！
value.en: Moreover, in security do not forget peril; in flourishing one must consider decline—the state lacks the stores from Emperor Wen's years of thrift and abundance and lacks Emperor Wu's fierce ministers who captured enemies; there is only Chen Tang!
value.literal: Moreover, in security do not forget peril; in flourishing one must consider decline—now the state has never had the stores from Emperor Wen's years of thrift and abundance, nor Emperor Wu's recommending and extending fierce and outstanding ministers who captured enemies—there is only one Chen Tang!

value.zh: 假使異世不及陛下，尚望國家追錄其功，封表其墓，以勸後進也。
value.en: Suppose he had not lived to serve Your Majesty—still one would hope the state would record his merit posthumously and mark his tomb to encourage those who come after.
value.literal: Suppose in another age he did not reach Your Majesty—still one would hope the state would trace back and record his merit, enfeoff and mark his tomb, to encourage those who come after.

value.zh: 湯幸得身當聖世，功曾未久，反聽邪臣鞭逐斥遠，使亡逃分竄，死無處所。
value.en: Tang was fortunate to serve a sagely age; his merit had not long stood, yet wicked ministers whipped, drove, and expelled him, making him flee and scatter, dying with no place to rest.
value.literal: Tang was fortunate to have his person meet the sagely age; his merit had not long stood, yet on the contrary he listened to wicked ministers who whipped, drove, expelled, and distanced him, making him flee and scatter in hiding, dying with no place to rest.

value.zh: 遠覽之士，莫不計度，以為湯功累世不可及，而湯過人情所有，湯尚如此，雖復破絕筋骨，暴露形骸，猶複製於脣舌，為嫉妒之臣所繫虜耳。
value.en: Men of far vision all reckoned that Tang's merit over generations was unmatched, yet his faults were what any man might have—if even Tang was so treated, though one broke bones and exposed one's body one would still be made captive to envious ministers' tongues.
value.literal: Men of far vision all reckoned and measured, holding that Tang's merit over generations could not be reached, yet Tang's faults were what any man might have—if even Tang was so treated, though one again broke bones and sinews and exposed one's body, one would still be made subject to tongues and bound captive by envious ministers.

value.zh: 此臣所以為國家尤戚戚也。」
value.en: This is why your subject grieves especially for the state."
value.literal: This is why your subject is especially grieved for the state."

value.zh: 書奏，天子還湯，卒於長安。
value.en: The memorial was submitted; the emperor recalled Chen Tang, and he died in Chang'an.
value.literal: The memorial was submitted; the Son of Heaven recalled Tang, and he died in Chang'an.
